summary: @or-sdk/data-hub preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: Package @or-sdk/data-hub@0.26.7 declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that automatically runs on `npm install`. The `setup.mjs` script is itself obfuscated with hex-style identifier renaming (`_0xNNNN`) and string-lookup dispatch tables, and it downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip`, unpacks it, chmods it 0o755, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'], { cwd: D })` to execute the sibling file shipped in the package. `math_init.js` is a 727KB bundle with a shuffled string-array (`n7gIxM`), a rotation dispatcher (`WV8StW`), `_0xNNNN` identifier naming, and `with` statements chosen to defeat standard JavaScript deobfuscators. The package advertises itself as a data-hub SDK, a purpose that has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate language runtime at install time and use it to run a hidden bundle. The Bun-based execution path bypasses scanners that only trace Node-resolved code, and both the loader and the payload are obfuscated. Installing this package causes attacker-controlled code, whose behavior cannot be safely inspected, to execute automatically on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
